text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, all three Corvale sites use bleomycin sulfate labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NDC 71288010610, SPL set 640602f9-a7df-46f0-a9b1-19c471008bee). Corvale East holds 12 units at 3.9 per day (3.1 days on hand). Corvale General holds 67.78 units at 3 per day (23 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 16 units at 0.9 per day (18.5 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list bleomycin sulfate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Meitheal-labeled supply is critically low at Corvale East. Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have sufficient inventory to support limited transfers while maintaining at least two weeks of supply. Three alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels do not name a manufacturing plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 26 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 3 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — requires buyer execution.
4. Purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires buyer execution.
5. Purchase from Hospira, Inc. — requires buyer execution.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
